prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one square full-body character concept for a dark fairytale mobile game, detailed painterly gouache and ink, muted colors, neutral warm gray paper background, no text. Image 1 is the EXACT species/style reference MobDrownedMoon; image 2 is the source Spine rig silhouette reference, NOT its bright art style. A king miniboss of the SAME water-drop species. Broad squat legless soft translucent smoky teal watery body, two short flipper arms, mournful hollow oval eyes, tiny mouth, face directed LEFT in gentle 3/4 view, never humanoid. A faint mist-blurred circular moon containing a CLOSED EYELID with downward lashes appears INSIDE the lower right belly, subtle not a sharp logo. No floating head bead. Preserve source king construction: broad water body plus two-part crown sitting on top, no new legs, weapons, tentacles or detached orbiting objects. Full crown and arms visible, simple readable shapes, cute but uncanny, not gruesome. Variant A 'Drowned Crown King': an ancient tarnished bronze crown with three bent arch ribs and a cracked dull moonstone, tilted heavily into the soft head; old waterlogged pale reed-fiber lining replaces royal fur. Very sparse dark algae on the crown. Water body heavier and deeper slate-blue than the normal specimen; solemn small sad face. The strangeness is a forgotten drowned king carrying the reflection of the sleeping moon in his belly. Crown about one third of full height, body broad and regal. Single character only.

Use case: compositing. Make a portrait 9:16 dark-fairytale battle CONCEPT illustration. Image 1 is the exact scene to edit: preserve its moon with closed eye and downward lashes, cabin, river, lighting, camera and ink/gouache style. Image 2 is the king to insert, preserve its EXACT design. Image 3 is the ordinary species reference. Composition: red hood on left facing right, KING on right facing left, ONE small ordinary water blob between them slightly to right of center facing left. All touch SAME ground line at 77% image height so their scale comparison is honest. King INCLUDING crown is exactly TWICE ordinary blob full height, and about 1.35x red hood height. King body alone is 1.35x ordinary body height, king total width about 1.65x ordinary width. Keep king at x76%, width39% image, full height29% image; ordinary blob at x47%, width21%, height14.5%; red hood at x20%, height22%. Ensure no overlap hides either face or moon marking. Move/resize existing normal blob to make room for king, do not leave an extra copy. Hero short tattered cape falls to hips, no ground-length cape. Keep original lantern scythe. Both water monsters have blurred subtle closed-eye moon inside belly, no floating head bead. No UI no text no borders. Only foreground characters change; same night riverside cabin scene.

Edit this battle concept precisely. Keep background and red hood unchanged. Fix scale and clipping: reduce the large crowned water king by 12% uniformly with ground contact unchanged, move it LEFT enough that its right flipper is fully inside frame with 35px margin. Increase the ordinary water blob by 25% uniformly, keeping ground line unchanged, and shift slightly left if needed. Keep all faces clear, separate silhouettes, no overlaps, no other changes. The king should be about twice the ordinary blob height including crown. Preserve exact monster designs and hazy closed-eye moons. Output same portrait 9:16.

EVERYTHING ELSE unchanged: ordinary small water blob, red hood with short cape, lantern scythe, cabin, trees, sky eyed moon, camera, lighting. Full flippers inside frame.
